[quote=oppressive_airstrikes;58558617][u][b]Elladia Demokratia / The Republic of Elladi[/b][/u]
[b]An introductory/founding post of Elladia, as well as a hail to experienced roleplayers in the region.[/b]

[b]Presidential and parliamentary elections conclude with a landslide victory of the old guard, in spite of gradually growing opposition tally for the democratic faction.[/b]

It didn't take for the formal release of electoral results of the presidential election of the 21st of February, 2025 to signal an elated response within the nation of Elladi. Already did the bells of many Ektheievlai churces hall through both cities and the countryside the night before, hailing emerging crowds of ecstatic pro-government supporters, sporting the banners of the ruling Elladi Unity Party (EUP). It was especially the Elladikonized Cyrat that formed the bulwark of these activists, as was the case for the prior three presidential elections. Such celebrations were not present during the parliamentary elections of two weeks before, for those could not compare to the re-election of their darling candidate, Kynthia Elenaeia Ekateikis. It was reflected in the election tally alone, with 72,84% of the nation casting their ballot in favor of the re-elected President and head of the EUP.

The sixty-four year old Elladikoan has retained their favor three times already, and now it shall the the fourth time that the Republic's founder would ascend to the position of President, for another six years to come. However, this innate support is something that is waning. It has been eighteen years ever since the end of the Elladi Civil War, which marked her and the EUP's ascension to power, initially on a platform of egalitaranism, at least on paper. President Ekateikis' former three presidencies have gradually introduced a subtle return of Elladikoan supremacism, especially in the form of the maintenance of "light" policies of segregation, as well as the staffing of nearly all government and military posts with Elladikoan staffers and officers. The loyalty of the human subjects has been retained through a pursuit of state-led, left-wing interventionist economic policies, which brought about at least a dignified existence to vast swathes of the Cyrat people within the borders of the Republic itself.

An improvement of the abysmal living conditions experienced during the Chalkassean Authority have, however, not managed to fully placate an increasingly more louder and radical democratic opposition. The People's Democratic Alliance (PDA), founded in 2018 as a means to organize human veterans of the civil war, as well as frustrated civilian politicians and activist organizers of the Cyrat people, has been relegated to opposition status once more with a meagre 24 seats (18,75%~) in a parliament of 128 seats.

The PDA has been keen to complain about "electoral irregularities" and the presence of aggressive EUP supporters, to the point of decrying the "cultural betrayal" of Elladikonized Cyrat voters and citizens in the wake of the fourth parliamentary and presidential elections. The EUP and the nation's judicial apparatus, the obviously military-bound and controlled Constitutional Court of Elladi have denied the complaints as valid, highlighting that the pro-EUP and pro-Ekateikis activists and party-affiliate groups had a right to "the freedom of assembly and political expression". The Constitutional Court of Elladi, alongside the supportive statement of the Elladikoan-only Upper Chamber, have also highlighted that, quote, "Popular, political formations in support of our noble President Kynthia Elenaeia Ekateikis exercise a patriotic, civic duty that permits for their inclusion in administrative, policing actions that permit for the safe conduct of free and fair elections in the Republic of Elladi."

[b]Exploitation of Crude Oil to intensify in the province of Greater Bayrut & municipality of Bayrut.[/b]

Relatively centralized in it's advantageous position as a bay-adjacent harbor city, Bayrut has been the principal means for import and export into the wide world for the Republic of Elladi. It's attached province, Greater Bayrut, has been the EUP government's focus for the Cyrat-majority lowlands of the nation for some past four to five years. Accessible oil deposits in close proximity to the urbanized settlement have brought about great wealth to the local government and their attached House Aneiseatakis, as did they bring great pollution to the ever-expanding, slummed state housing districts clinging to the outskirts of the city itself.

Geological surveys and uninterrupted exploration eastwards and northeastwards of the city proper have yielded acceptable results. The Elladikoan Armed Forces' Engineers' report on the discovery of several oil deposits further into the dry grasslands have brought about the eye of the government on the otherwise barren lands of the northeastern section of Greater Bayrut. While these deposits are not as accessible to the city-bound ones, they nevertheless represent a substantial amount of extractable resources adequate for a profit-healthy extraction.

House Aneiseatakis has already pledged to assist the Elladikoan Republic's military in securing, developing and exploiting these resources, as is the custom for any prestigious family appointed to the Upper Chamber. House Anteisatakis' Provincial Guard is to be assigned this task, as is convention. The Elladikoan Armed Forces have responded favorably to the pledge, with the approval of the now-acting President Ekateikis' own House, as too is convention.

The process of securing the oil deposits is not expected to yield any violent confrontation with local elements, which are already subject to Elladi rule of law and the potential brutal response of the Armed Forces, let alone the national police force. The Provincial Guard of House Anteisatakis has been shifting it's attention southwards, beyond the maritime borders of it's Ciryat-majority jewel of Bayrut city. A functional threat could only manifest itself in the form of negative attention from the [nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]. (*1) The United Lavian Republic has not bothered the Republic of Elladi for the time being, so tensions as of current remain low in the eyes of the EUP-led government.
